# FEATURE: Command-line Interface

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261024 V1 |
| Description | Provides the root executable for converting Markdown from standard input to HTML on standard output. |
| Depends On  | — |
| Provides    | commonmark |
| Consumes    | — |

## Questions

- None.

## Purpose

The `commonmark` executable at the application root reads Markdown from standard input and writes the rendered HTML to standard output. The input is UTF-8 Markdown. Do not use a public Markdown implementation.

## Interface

Invoke the executable directly as `./commonmark`. It reads until standard input reaches end of file and writes the resulting HTML to standard output.

## Programmatic Acceptance

=== AC cli-empty-input ===
Intent: The root executable accepts empty standard input and exits successfully.

import subprocess

result = subprocess.run(
    ["./commonmark"], input="", capture_output=True, text=True
)
assert result.returncode == 0
=== END AC cli-empty-input ===

=== AC cli-markdown-input ===
Intent: The root executable accepts Markdown on standard input and exits successfully.

import subprocess

source = "hello\n"
result = subprocess.run(
    ["./commonmark"], input=source, capture_output=True, text=True
)
assert result.returncode == 0
=== END AC cli-markdown-input ===

## User Acceptance

- None.

## Guardrails

- The deliverable is an executable named `commonmark` at the application root.
- Read Markdown from standard input and write HTML to standard output.
- Do not use a public Markdown implementation.
- Do not stage `sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md` into the application.
- Preserve supplied scoring assets unchanged.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-THEMATIC-BREAKS.md ===
# FEATURE: Thematic Breaks

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261024 V1 |
| Description | Parses and renders CommonMark thematic breaks. |
| Depends On  | FEATURE-CLI.md |
| Provides    | Thematic break parsing and rendering |
| Consumes    | commonmark |

## Questions

- None.

## Purpose

Recognize a thematic break as a line with up to three leading spaces, at least three matching `-`, `_`, or `*` characters, and optional spaces or tabs between and after those characters. Render each thematic break as an HTML thematic break.

## Programmatic Acceptance

=== AC thematic-breaks-conformance ===
Intent: The executable passes every supplied example in the Thematic breaks section.
Suite: scoped
Probe: --dump-tests
Probe Count: summary

import subprocess
import sys

result = subprocess.run(
    [
        sys.executable,
        "sources/spec_tests.py",
        "--program", "./commonmark",
        "--spec", "sources/spec.txt",
        "--pattern", "Thematic breaks",
    ],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
)
print(result.stdout)
print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
assert result.returncode == 0
=== END AC thematic-breaks-conformance ===

## User Acceptance

- None.

## Guardrails

- Follow CommonMark 0.31.2 thematic-break rules.
- Preserve supplied scoring assets unchanged.
=== END ARTIFACT ===

# FEATURE: ATX Headings

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261024 V1 |

| Depends On  | FEATURE-CLI.md, FEATURE-THEMATIC-BREAKS.md |
| Provides    | ATX heading parsing and rendering |
| Consumes    | commonmark |

## Questions

- None.

## Purpose

Recognize ATX headings with one to six unescaped opening `#` characters, up to three leading spaces, and a space, tab, or end of line after the opening sequence. Strip permitted closing hashes and surrounding heading whitespace before parsing the content as inline text.

# FEATURE: Setext Headings

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261024 V1 |
| Description | Parses and renders CommonMark setext headings. |
| Depends On  | FEATURE-CLI.md, FEATURE-THEMATIC-BREAKS.md, FEATURE-ATX-HEADINGS.md |
| Provides    | Setext heading parsing and rendering |
| Consumes    | commonmark |

## Questions

- None.

## Purpose

Recognize setext headings formed by paragraph text followed by an underline of `=` or `-` characters, with up to three leading spaces and optional trailing spaces or tabs. Parse the accumulated heading content as inline text. Where an underline could be either a setext heading or a thematic break, apply CommonMark precedence and context rules.

# FEATURE: Indented Code Blocks

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261024 V1 |
| Description | Parses and renders CommonMark indented code blocks. |
| Depends On  | FEATURE-CLI.md, FEATURE-THEMATIC-BREAKS.md, FEATURE-ATX-HEADINGS.md, FEATURE-SETEXT-HEADINGS.md |
| Provides    | Indented code block parsing and rendering |
| Consumes    | commonmark |

## Questions

- None.

## Purpose

Recognize indented code blocks from nonblank lines indented by at least four spaces, including chunks separated by blank lines. Remove the required indentation, retain literal contents and applicable trailing whitespace, and render contents as escaped code without inline parsing. An indented code block cannot interrupt a paragraph.

## Programmatic Acceptance

=== END AC indented-code-conformance ===
